name: SubTick
description: Experimental timestamp-based input scheduling inside Geometry Dash physics ticks.

enabled.name: Enable SubTick
enabled.description: Use the timestamp timeline while playing supported levels.

mode.name: Input mode
mode.description: Compatibility avoids splitting buffer-sensitive airborne states. Exact splits every input-bearing player tick.

timing-note.name: Timing model
timing-note.description: SubTick uses Geode input timestamps and the game's actual PlayerObject physics updates. Render frames do not directly choose the input position.

physics-note.name: Physics note
physics-note.description: Splitting a physics tick changes the order of integration and collision work. Exact mode is experimental and may behave differently from vanilla physics.
